test_title: PYST 57: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting second to the left of C. Only two people are sitting between B and D. D is an immediate neighbour of C. A is sitting third to the right of F. E is sitting to the immediate left of G.

What is the position of E with respect to B?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

B is sitting second to the left of C. Only two people are sitting between B and D. D is an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/970e912d57eddb215e3837445158e5ab1b88daf7b22226a6f7976ec24f8c2699.png] 

A is sitting third to the right of E. F is sitting to the immediate left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b82c1d19c97a5e3a6f9319cc53834889241d6b3a868c8b20f20211f8859534da.png] 

Thus, the E's position is Second to the left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
